code: LOAD with an unformatted backup RAM (US)
effect: FILE CABINET ISN'T FORMATTED, FORMAT IT NOW? YES formats it; Japan instead says the data is broken and offers to erase it, which does nothing
note: The US LOAD screen adds a case for read result $FF (06:92E4, CMP #$FF) that shows message $0B and calls the format routine $F2D2 on YES. Japan's 06:92E4 is CMP #$01 only: every read error shows データーガ コワレテイマス / データーヲ ケシマスカ?, and YES calls the delete routine $F351, which fails on an unformatted cabinet, so the prompt stays. In Mesen, backup RAM zeroed at the file list, file 1 chosen. Image: US prompt, YES, the file list again.

effect: An unused boss sprite set: robot arm segments, ring joints and hydraulic parts
note: The graphics directory (bank $0A, $4000, 122 entries; loader 01:C000) has entries no code, stage list, boss table or screen script names, and no run loads. Entry 35 is packed like the boss sets 25-34 (mode $12) and holds about 63 cells of mechanical art; only 5 of its 186 pieces appear in any used boss set.
